name: Fairy Trickster

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: After you Disengage on your turn, ignore Difficult Terrain’s extra movement cost for the rest of the turn. On an attack hit, force a Wisdom save against DC 8 + the increased ability’s modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Failure gives Disadvantage on saves until your next turn ends. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Flustering Strike
benefits.summary: On an attack hit, force a Wisdom save against DC 8 + the increased ability’s modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Failure gives Disadvantage on saves until your next turn ends. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
benefits.text: When you hit with an attack roll, you can force the target to make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + the modifier of the ability this feat raised + your Proficiency Bonus); on a failure it has Disadvantage on saving throws until the end of your next turn. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest. In a fight, arm it on the hotbar before the attack.
